newsitem.title: USA: NY sets public hearings on utility restructuring.
newsitem.headline: NY sets public hearings on utility restructuring.

text.p: The New York State Public Service Commission said Tuesday it has scheduled a statewide series of open education forums and public statement hearings to seek consumer views on restructuring and rate proposals from five of the state's seven electric utilities.
These plans were filed with the commission October 1, detailing how the companies propose to restructure in a competitive electric marketplace.
A commission spokesman said there will be no hearings on Niagara Mohawk Power Corp's PowerChoice proposal submitted in late 1995.
PowerChoice was cited by the commission in its May decision on its Competitive Opportunities Proceeding which required the October 1 filings.
Long Island Lighting Co was exempted from the filing requirement because its rates and structure are being examined by the commission and the Long Island Power Authority, respectively.

The commission said it has scheduled 16 public statement hearings in the areas served by the other five -- Central Hudson Gas & Electric Corp, Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc, New York State Electric & Gas Corp, Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc, and Rochester Gas and Electric Corp.
